text:
jia: Quick Q — thinking about adding an error-injection harness into the switchover/coordinator so we can exercise rollback + fallback paths in staging. wanted to surface tradeoffs before prototyping.

sam: do you mean fault injection during a canary cutover (simulate partial failures) or a continuous chaos mode?

jia: partial failures during the canary window. e.g., force a probe failure, delay responses from new-variant pool, drop KV-cache warmup for some sessions. not full chaos, more surgical.

maria: fwiw we already have a simple simulator in eng-runtime, but it runs offline and doesn't exercise the real rollout controller. integrating a harness into the coordinator would catch orchestration gaps. +1 from me.

noah: major tradeoffs: (1) risk of test traffic hitting prod-like infra (need strong isolation), (2) complexity in the coordinator codepath, (3) observability hygiene so alerts aren't noisy. can we confine it to staging namespaces?

jia: yes staging-first. but we also want a smoke-on-every-deploy mode for canaries in pre-prod so regressions surface. thinking about making the harness an optional plugin behind feature flags and RBAC.

elaine: how would this surface in telemetry? we should be able to tag injected runs so evals/quality signals ignore them or compare them separately. otherwise we poison alerting.

sam: interface idea: coordinator exposes a small DecisionPlane API that accepts an "injection_profile" when creating a rollout. e.g.

```yaml
# example injection profile passed with rollout request
injection_profile:
  name: "staging-partial-drop"
  drop_percentage: 20
  delay_ms: 200
  target: "new_variant_pool"
  duration: "15m"
```

sam: then the ActionPlane (the runtime) subscribes to the profile and executes controls (drop/delay) locally. keeps decision vs action boundary clean.

maria: that separation is nice. also lets eng-runtime implement it safely (sandboxing + token gating). Do we need a fallback for when the injection mechanism fails? we don't want injections to block rollouts.

jia: yes, fail-open semantics: if the injection plugin errors, coordinator should log and continue without injection. only blocking for explicit test runs.

noah: question about state: if we inject failures that cause a rollback, do we persist the reason as "injected-failure" so later audits can filter? auditability is important for postmortems.

elaine: +1 persist metadata: rollout.metadata.injected = true and rollout.metadata.injection_profile = <id>. helps evals and billing too.

sam: implementation note: prefer event-sourced signals for injection events instead of mutating rollout state directly. a side-channel events stream with strong timestamps lets us replay and reconstruct decisions.

maria: one more ops concern: we need a kill-switch for runaway injection (operator can abort profile). maybe a controller-level circuit that listens for "operator-stop" and immediately tears down active injections.

jia: agreed. a sane default would be an operator abort that triggers immediate teardown and a no-delay rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy started: coordinator-injection-proto v0.1 -> staging at 1768002475 :construction:

noah: also consider an offline mode that runs the exact same decision logic but mocks the action plane. cheap and safer for perf testing. This helps test the decision algorithms without any infra risk.

maria: That gives us two modes: "mocked-action" (decision-only) and "live-action" (exercise runtime). both useful.

elaine: telemetry contract: injection events must emit a pair: `injection.start` and `injection.stop` with tags {profile, rollout_id, operator}. plus probe-level tags for any induced errors.

sam: long-term refactor: split coordinator into DecisionPlane service + lightweight Orchestrator that delegates to region ActionPlanes. DecisionPlane owns policies, ActonPlanes execute. clean upgrade path and easier testing.

jia: OK next steps: 1) draft API for injection_profile (sam), 2) sketch event schema and audit fields (noah/elaine), 3) rollout controller changes + fail-open semantics (maria). I'll open an RFC and link it here.

jia: RFC draft link: https://redwood.dev/rfcs/2026-01-switchover-injection-plugin (WIP)

sam: thanks — will prototype API stubs this week.

maria: I'll coordinate with eng-runtime to add a sandboxed injection shim.

noah: I'll draft the event schema and the operator kill-switch runbook.

elaine: I'll define the telemetry events and add filtering rules to the alerting repo.

jia: sweet. if anyone wants to pair on the prototype ping me. :raised_hands:

maria: pinged in #eng-runtime for pairing tomorrow.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: coordinator-injection-proto v0.1 -> staging at 1768002590 :white_check_mark:

jia: thanks all — closing the loop here, will open RFC today and tag reviewers.
